elements.name: footer
elements.doc: One-row key-hint bar drawn on the last terminal row wherever it is declared. items = "KEY|Label[|WHEN_FN];..."; KEY may be "@tui.action.name" to show the key currently bound to that action.

attributes.name: action
attributes.doc: function + args; several may be chained with ';'

attributes.name: when
attributes.doc: function name: the command is listed only while it succeeds

attributes.name: defaults
attributes.doc: comma/space separated default keybind groups to switch off for this page, e.g. "-quit,-scroll"

attributes.name: keep_state
attributes.doc: keep_state: every widget and pane of the page keeps value, cursor, scroll, selection, collapsed and size across page switches

attributes.name: focus_on_enter
attributes.doc: focus_on_enter: first (default), keep (the id focused when the page was last left) or the id of a widget

attributes.name: shell
attributes.doc: shell: a shell file (relative to this page) whose chrome stays while the user moves between its pages; the page builds into its <outlet/>

attributes.name: split
attributes.doc: width/height/gap: size tokens - N cells, N%, Nfr, fill, clamp(MIN,PREF,MAX); weight="N" is the same as Nfr

attributes.name: fuse
attributes.doc: fuse: on every child of a split - siblings share one border line; divider/divider_class style that line

attributes.name: resizable
attributes.doc: resizable: axes the user may resize on; handle: mouse zones (none = keyboard only); on_resize: FN PANE W H

attributes.name: keep_size
attributes.doc: keep_size: the pane's size after a resize survives a page switch (keep_collapsed is in collapseAttrs)

attributes.name: size_w
attributes.doc: split="fixed" only: every child is exactly size_w x size_h cells, flowed left to right and wrapped (tui.fixed)

attributes.name: span
attributes.doc: direct child of a split="fixed" parent only: width in cell units, and force a new row before this child

attributes.name: rows
attributes.doc: split="grid" only

attributes.name: grid_row
attributes.doc: direct child of a split="grid" parent only
